reviews.text: The folks at Hair of the Dog are always very nice and friendly and you get that they really care about your dog. Our dog, Dexter, comes out clean and relaxed and extra cute with his little bandanna. It’s great to go in and be greeted first by Sophia and then further greeted by smiles from the rest of the staff. A good experience all around.
Feebe and Fred are always so excited to get a monthly bath by Miryssa. My kids are well taken care of every visit.  Knowing they are getting the best treatment it's worth every dollar.
Incredibly kind and courteous staff great turnout, and the dog loved the entire process super to deal with

I was very disappointed with my experience. My dog is a gentle, 15-year-old dog who simply needed his nails trimmed. I was told that it required two people to hold him and was then charged an additional fee.

I have taken him to other groomers where they were able to trim his nails without needing extra assistance or charging an additional fee. I completely understand paying extra when a service genuinely requires additional time or staff, but in this case, I did not feel the extra charge was warranted.

What was most disappointing was the owner’s response when I raised my concern. I expected a more understanding and professional response, especially as a longtime pet owner advocating for my elderly dog. Overall, this experience left me very disappointed.

Stop looking for a groomer. THIS SHOULD BE THE LAST PLACE YOU TRY! They are phenomenal. We've been bringing chewy here for over a year now and they are such a great team and do a really good job. I feel comfortable dropping her off and chewy looks 10 years younger and happier when she leaves haha

Highly recommend Hair of the Dog!!

I genuinely don’t even know where to start with Hair of the Dog because they have been part of Thackery Binx’s life for SOOOO many years. I honestly feel like we were some of their very first customers, and at this point Myrissa and Daniel aren’t just his groomers, they are Aunt Myrissa and Uncle Daniel. We absolutely LOVE them.

And when I say Thackery Binx is a special boy, I mean SPECIAL. He has been through the ringer. Horrible experiences at boarding facilities, including one that ended in emergency dental surgery, a dog attack, bee stings, a scorpion sting, multiple allergic reactions, and being by our side through losing several immediate family members. He is extremely skittish and anxious, doesn’t trust people easily and has very sensitive skin and allergies. So trusting someone with him is a VERY big deal for us.

Does he still walk into Hair of the Dog shaking and acting like we have personally betrayed him? Absolutely. 😂 But we KNOW it is theatrics because we have literally caught him through the window loving all over Myrissa, Daniel and Sophia the second he thinks we’re gone. He comes out SO happy, looking amazing and with this little burst of confidence that makes my heart so happy every single time.

What means the most to me is that they genuinely KNOW him. They understand Binx needs patience and have built trust with a dog who does NOT give his trust easily. They take their time, know his sensitivities, respect his allergies and never make us feel like he is “too much.”

And I have to give Sophia her own shoutout because she is always SO bright and bubbly with him. She never just grabs his leash and rushes him back. She lets Binx take his time and waits for that little moment when you can almost see him realize, “Okay, I remember you. I think this is going to be okay.” She gives him kisses and hugs, lets him watch us walk out and waves goodbye with him before they get started. It may seem insignificant, but with an anxious dog like Binx, seeing someone respect what HE needs to feel safe means EVERYTHING.

They also take care of US. I travel constantly for work, so sometimes Grandma brings him in. They accommodate our crazy schedules and even let me handle payment over the phone so my mom doesn’t have to worry about anything. It truly feels like family.

I know some people mention the price or that their dog may be there for multiple hours, but personally, neither bothers me. I don’t WANT Binx rushed through an appointment. Let him decompress. Let them work at his pace. They call when HE is ready, not when I am ready to get him, and I LOVE that. Being able to drop him off and not spend those hours worrying about whether he is scared or being handled properly is priceless to me. The love, patience and care they give him is worth every single penny. I have never experienced this level of care with him anywhere else.

We bring Binx every 5–9 weeks depending on what he needs, and honestly, at this point Sophia and Myrissa are usually the ones texting US when it’s time for him to come back. 😂 We just show up! That is how much we trust them. You tell us when he needs to be back and we will make sure His Majesty is there.

Hair of the Dog has been with our family through so many ups and downs, and I hope they know how much they mean to us. They have loved and cared for our complicated, dramatic, sweet little Thackery Binx through every twist and turn. They are truly the BEST at what they do, but more importantly, they have some of the most loving and compassionate hearts in the world.

They’re not just Thackery Binx’s groomers anymore, they’re part of his little trust circle & our family. We love you guys!!! 🤍🐾

The whole staff was really great. Was super nervous to take one of my dogs because he's anxious around new people and dogs and usually barks like crazy. As soon as we walked in they greeted him like they knew him which kept him calm and he didn't bark once at them. They are really good with senior/ anxious dogs! Will definitely become a regular.
Amazing, exceptional service! My doggy loves coming here. Great staff.

We’ve been taking our pup here for years! He can be rather particular and other groomers have not been able to work with him but they are amazing at Hair of the Dog! He doesnt even get nervous to be there, he’s relaxed and happy. They do such a good job too, he’s always so soft and handsome after!
By far, my favorite pet groomer in town! very posh place! My golden doodle always comes looking & smelling like a preppy puppy!  He is always happy to go in. Friendly staff!
These folks are the best! Trust them completely with my dogs. The best!
Nice place very organized. Miryssa very nice. I recommend them highly
So impressed. We took our Siberian Husky for the first time. Sarah did an amazing job and our pup feels sooooo good. Will be back

Was surprised when rebooking they said they could no longer accommodate us bc of our dogs behavior. They did upcharge us because bad behavior but they never discussed he was no longer allowed, they actually reassured us they would do better at his next appt and not need to be upcharged.

My daughter takes my little Maltipoo to Hair of the Dog for me because I am unable to. We have been going there for about a year now, she has 2 beautiful dogs also, a huge one and a tiny one, tiny rules!! My Bucky went today and he looks beautiful!! I highly recommend !!!
The best place around! They are always so kind and their work speaks for itself. Best groomer in Phoenix hands down!
Our pups love everyone at this grooming salon and they take such great care of them. We have been customers for many years. Highly recommend!

Took my puppy in today to get his first nail trim and Molly took amazing care of him! She’s was super sweet, gentle, incredibly kind to him and did a fantastic job! I’m so grateful because my puppy is like my child and there are so many bad groomers out there but this place rocks! I can’t recommend them enough and they will be my go to groomer for both of my dogs! ❤️

It was my first time going there, i was nervous due to having bad experiences before with other groomers but Sarah really was amazing made me feel comfortable about leaving him there and they take their time which is a green flag in my book!
I would definitely recommend 👌🏻

Myrissa and her staff are so loving and kind to my "high needs" pup. He is always welcomed and cared for despite his nervous and snappy disposition. When he's especially anxious, they make time and space for him away from distractions. Somehow they always do a great job grooming him, and have not turned him away, even though he has nipped them! We are so grateful and highly recommended Hair of the Dog. 🐶🐾❤️
Not a great experience. Would recommend traveling 3 extra mins west and visiting that groomer.

They always do a great job and their communication is fantastic. Our dog gets nervous to go to new places but they make her feel comfortable every time we go. We couldn’t be happier to have found this groomer.

I can't say enough great things about this groomer! They took incredible care of my puppy during her very first grooming appointment, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. From the moment we walked in, they were warm, welcoming, and so gentle with her. It was clear they truly love what they do and have a natural way with animals.

They took the time to explain the process and made sure my pup was comfortable every step of the way. When I picked her up, she looked absolutely adorable. Neatly trimmed, clean, and smelling fantastic! But more importantly, she was happy and calm, which tells me she was treated with kindness and patience.

This groomer has earned a lifelong customer. If you're looking for someone who will treat your dog like their own, look no further!

Hair of the Dog on Greenway and Tatum is the best groomer I’ve ever had!! Just picked up Kate today. See pic attached of her happy face now that she’s had her spa day! I started going here about six months ago when my prior had appointments that were not kept or not available when I needed the grooming. I actually texted late on a Friday when my other cancelled with SOS to check availability. Not only did they call me back the same evening as a new customer, had a cancellation & got her in the next morning! That’s what I call five star service. Marissa & all groomers here run a small business. I really like that too & have my own business.They do a great grooming on Kate. Their shop is clean & smells fresh. The gals at the front always greet you with a smile & happy energy & take time to listen to your needs & how you want to have your pup cut. I now have a standing once a month appointment. They send me reminders by text for the next appointment and usually the day before. Five stars to the staff at Hair of the Dog! Highly recommend taking your dog here. Absolutely will not regret the great experience they will give you and your dog. Recommend texting them & book appointment at least a week ahead of time. Their text response may not be immediate, remember, they’re busy with the dogs. But do you get back usually later on that same day.
Our Mia always looks beautiful after her visit!  Thank you for being so kind and patient with our little girl!

I have been bringing my two dogs here monthly for the past three months and I have been very happy with the service at Hair of the Dog. Great communication and dogs look fresh and clean after two hours. So glad I've found this place!
Great experience and our Bernese Mountain dog looked fantastic.

They were super nice. My pups dewclaw had curved and grown into the pad of her  paw. They were very kind to me and my dog. And they were open regular hours on Sunday. Price is comparable to most places.

So far I have to say these folks are great! I have a very nervous/anxious dog (Milo) and they were so careful & gentle with him

I'm new to this area and look forward to bringing him here!

Hair of the Dog grooming.   We have 3 dogs and their Groomers do an Outstanding job with each one!!!   They are beautifully groomed and they treat our dogs like their own!   They are the Best Groomers we have ever had!!  We highly recommend them!

Having three dogs is stressful when looking for a groomer. We have found the perfect groomers with Hair of the Dogs in Phoenix! They always treat our fur babies with so much love and always have a great attitude! They always get them in and out in less than 3 hours, much better than any place we have ever taken them!

I texted the number on the website  to inquire about pricing for bringing my golden retriever in for a bath and trim. They promptly and very kindly answered all of my questions and I was able to schedule right then and there for the next day! I brought him in and the place was very close by, easy to find, had charming decor, and smelled good when you walked in the door! It also looked very tidy. The lady at the front desk greeted us with a smile, called my dog and I both by name, and went over everything we discussed over text! I left my dog there for three hours to get the full treatment and they called to let me know he was ready to be picked up! When my husband picked Sully up, he was happy, fluffy, smelled great, and his trim was exactly what I envisioned for a golden retriever trim. They also texted me directly after his visit to ask me if I was satisfied with everything and let me know how my dog did (this was his first groomer experience), which I very much appreciate the courtesy and attention to detail. Not only was his visit reasonably priced, the customer service was amazing, and my dog looks and smells great, they made us and my dog feel seen and heard in every way. We can't wait to go back!! 11/10 experience
We love hair of the dog! They always take such good care of our cavapoo and leave him looking and feeling and smelling fresh! It’s clear that the groomers really love dogs and enjoy what they do.

Hair of the Dog is the best place to get your dog groomed! I have a cockapoo that needs frequent grooming and she loves her groomer here. I have been getting her groomed here for over a year now and they do an amazing job getting her cleaned up. You can tell they love the dogs they work with!

I’ve been coming here for over two years now and they do a great job for my Brady every time! Absolutely love the bandanas they give him, they’re adorable and I now have a huge collection. Thanks guys!!

I really like this place. The staff is always nice and welcoming. I come here for regular nail trimmings for my dog, but the past few times the nails are inconsistently trimmed. One paw will be short and one paw will be long. 😩 I need to start catching it while I’m in store so I can mention it to them. I just feel that if I’m paying for a service there should be bit more attention to detail.
Molly is the BEST @ Hair of the Dog.  She gives so much TLC to our two Cavalier king Charles dogs (13  yrs & 3 1/2 yrs) . They LOVE going to see her
Great service very friendly staff
They do such a good job. You can get in pretty quickly, no waiting weeks for an appointment. And very reasonably priced.
Nice people and great grooming. I will be back!
Love them very good service! Daniel does a great job on my Yorkie. I have been going there for years. Everyone should try them❤️

We have been coming to Hair of the Dog for years and we absolutely love them. We have 2 pups and they always look adorable after every grooming. The groomers are very kind and receptive to what you want for your dogs. I recommend them to everyone I know!

My dog absolutely loves going to Hair of the Dog Grooming! Every time we visit, the staff is so welcoming, and my dog comes out looking and smelling incredible. His coat stays fresh for a full week after each grooming session, and I’ve had several people at the park compliment how great he smells. What’s even more impressive is that some fellow dog owners have mentioned their dogs used to hate getting their nails trimmed—other groomers weren’t even able to do it! But Hair of the Dog had no problem, making the experience stress-free for everyone. Highly recommend!

We’ve been going here with our large doodles for a few years and really love the service. The groomers treat them so well and always update us how they did. They always come away looking great! Highly recommend!

We have been taking our little Abby 🐶 to Hair of the Dog for about 2 1/2 years and couldn’t be happier. Since her first visit they had so much patience and treated her so well!!! Always leaving her so cute ☺️ never one complain except too …
